item.title: Report ref 10087349 posted this morning., 12th September
item.description:
Notices have been posted on the gates of Kelsey Park. Gates are being kept locked due to unauthorised encampment. As explained these people are gaining access late at night via the damaged fence and temporary metal frames erected by the council between the parade of shops carpark and park footpath on Wickham road. They are constantly being pulled out at the bottom for access into the park. What is the point of locking the gates if you are going to ignore the parks damaged/broken fences. No amount of temporary fixes are going to resolve this issue. A solid structure need to be put along this section of the park.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 82, Wickham Road, Beckenham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
